description: Alertmanager health: notifications, alerts, silences, nflog and resource usage.

panels.description: Alertmanager replicas with their version, uptime and last config reload.
panels.title: Instance versions and up time
Notifications sent from $pod
panels.description: Notifications sent per integration. Failed notifications are drawn on the negative axis.

panels.title: Notification durations per integration on $pod
panels.description: Notification send latency per integration, 0.9 and 0.99 quantiles.

panels.title: Active alerts in $pod
panels.description: Alerts held by Alertmanager, by state.

panels.title: Received alerts by status for $pod
panels.description: Alerts received from Prometheus. Resolved is drawn on the negative axis.

panels.title: Cluster members
panels.description: Peers each replica sees. Red below the replica count.

panels.title: Cluster health score
panels.description: 0 is healthy; anything above means the gossip mesh has not converged.

panels.title: Cluster failed peers
panels.description: Peers the replica can no longer reach.

panels.title: Cluster messages queued
panels.description: Gossip messages waiting to broadcast. A queue that does not drain means the mesh is not keeping up.

panels.title: Cluster peer churn
panels.description: Peers joining and leaving the gossip mesh. Sustained churn precedes AlertmanagerClusterFailedToSendAlerts.

panels.title: CPU usage/s for $pod
panels.description: Cores used. The cluster sets no CPU limits, so there is no limit line.
